# Natassa Pippa

> Natassa Pippa (Νατάσσα Πίππα) is Associate Professor of Pharmaceutical Technology at the National and Kapodistrian University of Athens (NKUA / ΕΚΠΑ), Department of Pharmacy, Division of Pharmaceutical Technology. The same person is also written Natasa Pippa (one s), Natassa Pipa (one p), and Natasa Pipa. The site is one page. The same page can be shown in Greek with the language switch, or opened at https://natassapippa.gr/?lang=el.

Single page: https://natassapippa.gr/
Section links below are anchors on that page, not separate documents. For the full publication list, use Google Scholar or Scopus rather than the selected items on the page.

- Email: natpippa@pharm.uoa.gr
- Phone: +30 6946253628, +30 210 7274037
- Address: University Campus, 15771 Athens, Greece
- Research: drug delivery systems (liposomes, polymersomes, nanoemulsions, dendrimers, micelles, hydrogels), nanomedicine, physicochemical characterization, and quality assurance of medicines, cosmetics, food supplements, and medical devices.
- Notable selected papers on the page include work in Nature Aging (2025), Molecular Cell (2023), Langmuir (2024), and Journal of Materials Chemistry B (2024).
- Distinctions on the page include the L'Oréal-UNESCO For Women in Science award (2021), the IAAM Young Scientist Award, the IAAM Scientist Medal (2016), and the 68th Lindau Nobel Laureate Meeting (2018).
